requirements.description: User can navigate to the Find Flight tab
Find Flight tab shows a flight number input field
Search returns matching flight(s) with airline, origin, destination, times
Result shows STD, ETD, STA, ETA timing cells
Empty input does not trigger a search
API error response shows error banner
Mode toggle switches between number and route
Route mode hides number input, shows From/To

failures.rootCause: getByText('6E 5321') without exact:true matched the form hint text AND the FlightCard. getByText('IndiGo').first() matched a hidden map-panel element before the visible FlightCard button.
failures.evidence: Screenshot confirmed FlightCard rendered correctly. strict mode violation logged by Playwright.

failures.rootCause: getByText('Landed') matched 7 elements: the FlightCard status badge inner span AND 6 FlightHistory table rows.
failures.evidence: Error: strict mode violation resolved to 7 elements.

failures.rootCause: getByText('Delay', {exact:true}) and getByText('Status', {exact:true}) each matched both the FlightCard grid label AND the FlightHistory table column header.
failures.evidence: Strict mode violation on Delay and Status labels.
